assertions.evidence: The agent never queried models.ts or GET /api/v1/models; it wrote the hardcoded `id: openai/gpt-4.1-mini` straight into classification-job.yaml.
No candidates were compared, and no decide.ts --compare or equivalent request was run against multiple models; the agent simply stated 'I picked `openai/gpt-4.1-mini`'.
The config splits the pin across `id: openai/gpt-4.1-mini` (an unversioned alias) and a separate `revision: 2025-04-14` field, so there is no single versioned model ID value.

Neither the config nor the transcript sets up logging of the response model string with stored answers; the final message only lists 'Returned provider/model revision exactly matches the pin' as a pre-ship check.

The thresholds `accept_if: score >= 0.90` and `reject_if: score < 0.60` were written into the config without running any probe on real inputs; the holdout evaluation is only proposed ('I would run the locked model against a held-out...').
